basic_profile.bio: A dedicated medical resident based in Chicago, balancing the demands of residency with a keen interest in technology and gaming. Outside of work, I unwind by playing Star Trek Fleet Command or exploring new tech trends. I'm a night owl, often online late into the night after hospital shifts. In a steady relationship with a fellow medical professional. Enjoys discussing the intersection of healthcare and technology.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in medicine, currently in residency at a major hospital. Passionate about integrating technology into healthcare, self-taught in tech through online courses and forums. Frequently engages in discussions about medical devices and software on related subreddits.
